hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: DATASET_NAME
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: should match the second level of concept paths provided by recover.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -o pipefail cd "_scripts/recover/job_scripts_adult"
conn_user='postgres' conn_pass=`aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id 'rds!db-2b115560-c8c4-4cec-8418-537a35f9c192' --region 'us-east-1' --query SecretString --output text | jq -r .password` if [[ $? != 0 ]] || [[ -z $conn_pass ]] then echo "Secretsmanager call failed" exit 255 else echo "Secretsmanager call succeeded" fi database_psql_host_address='recoverdb.cljahwnkfisu.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com' DB="${DATASET_NAME,,}_${VERSION,,}"
echo "testing connection to db" PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet \ --host="$database_psql_host_address" \ --port="5432" \ --username="$conn_user" \ --dbname="$DB" \ -c "\q" # This command tests the connection and exits
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "Connection test failed!" exit 255 else echo "Connection test succeeded - conn_user=$conn_user database_psql_host_address=$database_psql_host_address DB=$DB" fi
if ${answerdata}; then PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f answerdata/get_answerdata_rollup.sql && \ PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f answerdata/get_answerdata_crosstabs.sql && \ PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f answerdata/answerdata_metadata_builder.sql & fi
if ${biospecimens}; then PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f biospecimens/get_biospecimen_rollup.sql && \ PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f biospecimens/get_biospecimens_subtables.sql && \ PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f biospecimens/biospecimens_metadata_builder.sql & fi
if ${demographics}; then PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f demographics/copy_demographics_table.sql && \ PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f demographics/demographics_metadata_builder.sql & fi if ${fitbit}; then PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f fitbit/get_fitbit_crosstables.sql && \ PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f fitbit/fitbit_metadata_builder.sql & fi if ${visits}; then PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f visits/get_visits_subtables.sql && \ PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f visits/visits_metadata_builder.sql & fi if ${derived_core}; then PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f derived_core/copy_derived_core_table.sql && \ PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f derived_core/derived_core_metadata_builder.sql & fi if ${derived_visits}; then PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f derived_visits/get_derived_visits_subtables.sql && \ PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f derived_visits/derived_visits_metadata_builder.sql & fi if ${derived_symptoms}; then PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f derived_symptoms/get_derived_symptoms_subtables.sql && \ PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f derived_symptoms/derived_symptoms_metadata_builder.sql & fi wait; echo "completed curation, moving to merge meta stage"; PGPASSWORD="$conn_pass" psql --quiet --host="$database_psql_host_address" --port="5432" --dbname="$DB" -U $conn_user \ -f metadata_curation/dataset_metadata_merge.sql
